note: Flown aircraft whose maker publishes enough to test HS's hover-time arithmetic. Each gives mass, pack and stated flight time; the power data is a bench table or the maker's stated hover efficiency.

power.quote: Together with the bitcraze 55-35 mm propeller we manage to achieve a system efficiency of over 5 W/g during hover ... hover time ... a bit over 10 minutes (the unit is g/W: 5 W per gram would be 170 W for a 34 g aircraft)
